# Keys of well-known brand and chain names that no sign may spell, for the world crate's
# tests only (never shipped, never read by the game). Each line is the FNV-1a 64 hash of a
# name's letters and digits, uppercased (`key` in crates/world/src/signs/lexicon.rs); the
# names themselves stay out of the repo (CLAUDE.md: no real brand names anywhere). To add
# one, hash it the same way and append the key.
